name: grid emission factor
source: UNFCCC GHG emissions calculator ver01.1, md5 57d3ffd78a9f5f9980e15feb65f8d986; Electricity, heat, cooling!B192 (Iraq) = 0.93391 kg CO2e/kWh. Claim record claim-record/records/UNF_GRID_IRAQ.json.
_note: The downward levels are filled only where this repository has a
reading. -1 is measured here by perturbation; -2 and -3 are what
the factor rests on physically and this repository has measured
neither, so they carry ABSENT rather than a plausible number.
The upward levels are taken from the workbook's own Disclaimer!A3,

levels.severed: combustion chemistry: fuel carbon content to CO2e per unit energy
levels.still_acting: the actual carbon content of the fuel burned, which does not consult the factor

levels.severed: plant-level heat rate and dispatch order
levels.still_acting: which plants are on the margin at the hour the kWh is drawn

levels.severed: the national generation mix that the factor was averaged over
levels.still_acting: the mix keeps changing after the average was taken; nothing in the workbook re-reads it

clock.basis: stated in the delivery as a few years and taken as 3; NOT measured here

levels.still_acting: the factor multiplies whatever kWh figure the user enters

clock.basis: derived: time_constant 3.0 y / |coupling| 0.8815, coupling measured by perturbation in sheet-structure-scan/coupling.py

levels.goal: support organizations to estimate their GHG emissions
levels.severed: the relation between this factor and the accuracy of the estimate it feeds
levels.still_acting: users read the Report tab as an emissions figure
levels.source_disclaims: the same cell states the secretariat 'makes no representations as to the accuracy, completeness, suitability or validity of any information on this Spreadsheet'

levels.goal: raise awareness and promote climate action
levels.severed: the relation between an emissions estimate and any action taken
levels.still_acting: the number is published and read

levels.severed: the relation between climate action promoted and emissions reduced
levels.still_acting: emissions, which do not consult the estimate
